course_name_original: UE Introduction aux circuits hydrauliques et aux pompes
course_name_en: Introduction to hydraulic circuits and pumps
prerequisites: Basic knowledge of physics and fluid mechanics: Newton's laws, continuity equation, Bernoulli's equation.

learning_outcomes.text: Be able to analyze or size a simple hydraulic circuit.

Be able to identify the different phenomena present in a hydraulic installation (industrial or domestic) and be able to size a hydraulic installation (selection of pumps, sizing of installations and selection of installation accessories).

syllabus_topics: Concepts of head and head loss in conduits.
Networks: series and parallel configuration of pumps and conduits.
degree: Licence Mécanique, parcours Génie mécanique et productique (2e et 3e année)
